notes:
Original contrast includes heritage learners; replication contrast includes foreign-language learners only. Preserve printed contrast direction: replication d is negative for Low-High. Supplied replication page locator differs from acquired preprint pagination; Table 4 identifies the test. Quotes normalize PDF glyphs and whitespace; ellipsis indicates omitted words.
Completion source review (n_o): Critical independent-sample t test explicitly compares 40 upper-division learners with 40 lower-division learners. These are mutually exclusive curricular groups. No participant exclusions from this test are reported.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Cohen d for the high-versus-low EIT comparison; no conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Exact printed p for the same independent-sample t test; retained as 0.000, without replacing by an inferred bound.
